datasheet_identity.title: S10AC THRU S10MC Surface Mount General Purpose Rectifier

extraction_notes: Forward-voltage and reverse-characteristics curves were digitized from the real plotted traces on p. 2 Fig. 3 and Fig. 4; Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 are thermal and surge-rating curves and were not extracted as diode electrical curves.
Fig. 3 is a typical forward characteristic at Tj = 25 degC with 300 us pulse width and 1% duty cycle; the plotted y-axis is logarithmic.

Fig. 4 contains separate Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 125 degC reverse-current traces; reverse-bias x values preserve the plotted percent-of-rated-peak-reverse-voltage axis and are converted to amperes on the y-axis.
The S10MC tabulated limits are VRRM = 1000 V, IF(AV) = 10.0 A, VF maximum = 1.0 V at IF = 10.0 A, and IR1 maximum = 2.0 uA at VR = VDC and TA = 25 degC.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery time and no breakdown-voltage test point; these fields are therefore null rather than inferred from the reverse curve.
